title: Which errors the vendor documents while onboarding Azure to DSPM, and the resolution each row gives

prose.text: {{role-not-found}} {{admin-consent}} {{invalid-input-region}} {{state-lock}} {{inconsistent-result}} {{conflict-error-parallelism}} {{terraform-version-mismatch}} {{cmk-already-exists}} Onboarding itself is in [[dspm.onboarding-azure]], with [[dspm.overview]] and [[dspm.scanning]] for DSPM generally.

checks.do: The exact error text against the documented rows; ManagementPolicyNotFound is documented with two different resolutions.
Which EncryptionAtHost command the page gives: the first row writes the namespace Micorsoft.Compute, the Cloud Shell row Microsoft.Compute.

role-not-found.statement: The CLI error "Role not found Error: loading Role Definition List: could not find role <role name>" or "Account in pending state from long time" is resolved by rerunning the template.

quotes: Account in pending state from long time | Rerun the template.

admin-consent.statement: The Admin Console message "Admin consent has not been granted to the necessary APIs. Please provide consent to the necessary APIs." is resolved by granting API permissions to the service principal.

quotes: Admin consent has not been granted to the necessary APIs. Please provide consent to the necessary APIs. | Grant API permissions to the service principal.

invalid-input-region.statement: The Terraform planning error "Invalid value for input variable" is resolved by entering at least one deployment region in the format ["region 1", "region 2"].

quotes: Invalid value for input variable | Enter at least one region where you want to deploy the template in the following format: ["region 1", "region 2"]

state-lock.statement: The CLI error "Error acquiring the state lock ... state blob is already locked" is resolved with terraform force-unlock <ID>.

quotes: state blob is already locked \| Lock Info: <lock ID> | Run terraform force-unlock <ID>

role-assignment-limit.statement: Azure status 400 with code RoleAssignmentLimitExceeded ("No more role assignments can be created") means the role assignment limit is exceeded; the documented fix is deleting a custom role.

quotes: Status=400 Code="RoleAssignmentLimitExceeded" No more role assignments can be created
No more role assignments can be created | The limit for role assignment is exceeded.

Delete any custom role to accommodate new requests. To delete custom roles: Sign in to the Azure portal and go to Management groups. Click Tenant Root Group. In the left-side navigation, click Access control (IAM). Select the Roles tab. Click the ellipsis icon and select Delete.

inconsistent-result.statement: "Error: Provider produced inconsistent result after apply" is resolved by running terraform destroy, redeploying the Azure onboarding template and using a different container in backend.tf.

quotes: Error: Provider produced inconsistent result after apply When applying changes to <managed identity details> | Run the terraform destroy command to purge the template. Download and deploy the Azure onboarding template. In the backend.tf file, ensure to use a different container.

access-mgmt-authfailed.statement: A local-exec provisioner error with AuthorizationFailed on az role assignment create is resolved by ensuring access management for Azure resources is enabled for your ID.

quotes: The client <username> with object ID <object ID> does not have authorization to perform action or the scope is invalid | Ensure that you have enabled access management for Azure resources for your ID.

encryption-at-host.statement: The InvalidParameter error that the Microsoft.compute/EncryptionAtHost feature is not enabled for the subscription is resolved by registering the EncryptionAtHost feature with az feature register.

quotes: Microsoft.compute/EncryptionAtHost' feature is not enabled for this subscription. | Run the following commands:
az feature register --name EncryptionAtHost --namespace Micorsoft.Compute

encryption-at-host-cloudshell.statement: In Cloud Shell, the InvalidParameter error that the Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost feature is not enabled, raised while updating a Linux Virtual Machine Scale Set, is resolved by az feature register and az feature show for EncryptionAtHost in Microsoft.Compute.

quotes: In Cloud Shell: Error: updating Linux Virtual Machine Scale Set
Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost' feature is not enabled for this subscription.
az feature register --name EncryptionAtHost --namespace Microsoft.Compute az feature show --name EncryptionAtHost --namespace Microsoft.Compute

keyvault-403.statement: A 403 Forbidden on checking the "api-key" secret in the key vault is resolved by ensuring the Key Vault Administrator role is assigned.

quotes: Status=403 Code="Forbidden" Caller is not authorized to perform action on resource.
Caller: appid-<app ID> | Ensure that you have the Key Vault Administrator role assigned.

vm-size-capacity.statement: When the Standard_D2s_v3 SKU fails for capacity restrictions in a location, the documented fix is to run terraform destroy, download the Azure Onboarding template, extract it to a new folder, edit the terraform.tfvars file and set primary_region to a region where Standard_D2s_V3 is available.

quotes: Standard_D2s_v3' is currently not available in location '<region name>'.
Run the terraform destroy command to delete any resources created post the template deployment.
From the Roles and Templates tab, download the Azure Onboarding template. Extract the template to a new folder and edit the terraform.tfvars file.
For primary_region, enter a region where Standard_D2s_V3 size is available. Deploy the Terraform template.

cmk-already-exists.statement: The error that a key "control-plane-cmk" already exists and must be imported into Terraform state is resolved with terraform import for module.control_plane...cmk_key; the worker-plane-cmk variant with terraform import for module.worker_plane["region"]...cmk_key.

quotes: Run terraform import "module.control_plane.module.encryption_key.azurerm_key_vault_key.cmk_key" "https://<vault name/keys/control-plane-cmk/resource ID"
Run terraform import "module.worker_plane["region"].module.encryption_key.azurerm_key_vault_key.cmk_key" "https://<vault name/keys/worker-plane-cmk/resource ID"

msi-connect.statement: "Failed to connect to MSI" while retrieving static website properties is resolved with az login; the 403 Authorization_RequestDenied "Insufficient privileges" error from Cloud Shell is also resolved with az login.

quotes: Please make sure MSI is configured correctly. \| Get Token request returned: <Response [400]> | Run az login
Insufficient privileges to complete the operation. | Run az login
unexpected status 403 (403 Forbidden) with error: Authorization_RequestDenied: Insufficient privileges to complete the operation.

mgmt-group-not-found.statement: During Tree Discovery deployment, ManagementGroupNotFound (404) is resolved by checking the entered Management Group ID in the Tenant Details section and deploying the Tree Discovery template again.

quotes: Status=404 Code="ManagementGroupNotFound"
The management group 'resource_group_name' cannot be found." | Check and provide the correct management group ID.

In the Tenant Details section, check the entered Management Group ID. Click Reset to edit the fields. Enter the correct management group ID. Click Apply. In the Connect to the Tenant section, download and deploy the Tree Discovery template.

needs-attention.statement: If the account moves to Needs Attention during template deployment, the documented resolution is to wait for the next DSPM validation or run the on-demand validation.

quotes: While deploying the template, the account moves to the Needs Attention state. | Wait for DSPM's next validation or run the on-demand validation.

cloudshell-stuck.statement: If Cloud Shell is stuck while deploying the template, abort the deployment and rerun the template.

quotes: Cloud Shell stuck while deploying the template. | Abort the template deployment and rerun the template.

client-address-not-authorized.statement: The key vault 403 "Client address is not autorized and caller is not a trusted service" is resolved by rerunning the template with the correct IP.

quotes: StatusCode=403 -- Client address is not autorized and caller is not a trusted service.
Client address is not autorized and caller is not a trusted service. | Rerun the template with the correct IP.

storage-authfailure.statement: A 403 AuthorizationFailure retrieving a storage queue is resolved by adding the system IP address to the Azure storage account and key vault IP networks.

quotes: unexpected status 403 (403 This request is not authorized to perform this operation.) with AuthorizationFailure
with AuthorizationFailure: This request is not authorized to perform this operation. | Add your system's IP address to the Azure storage account and Azure key vault's IP networks.

conflict-error-parallelism.statement: The ConflictError from an az keyvault update command run by a local-exec provisioner is resolved by running terraform apply -auto-approve -parallelism=1.

quotes: Error running command 'az keyvault update --name z-ebb21-96e29-secrets --public-network-access Enabled
ERROR: (ConflictError) A conflict occurred that prevented the operation from completing.
Follow this link for more information: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2147741 | Run terraform apply -auto-approve -parallelism=1

terraform-version-mismatch.statement: The "Resource type mismatch" error (a move from null_resource.management_reader to terraform_data.management_reader) is resolved by upgrading Terraform to the latest version.

quotes: which is a resource of a different type. | Upgrade Terraform to the latest version.

manual-delete-subnet.statement: The 400 errors for a subnet that cannot be deleted because it is in use and for a network security group in use (InUseNetworkSecurityGroupCannotBeDeleted) are resolved by deleting the resources manually in the Azure portal.

quotes: Failure sending request: StatusCode=400 Subnet <Subnet name> is in use by
cannot be deleted | Delete resources manually in Azure portal.
in use by the following resources: <Resource details> | Delete resources manually in Azure portal.
Code="InUseNetworkSecurityGroupCannotBeDeleted

manual-delete-dns-rg.statement: The 409 CannotDeleteResource for a Private DNS zone and the error that a resource group still contains resources are each resolved by deleting the resources manually in the Azure portal.

quotes: unexpected status 409 with error: CannotDeleteResource: Cannot delete resource while nested resources exist.
Please delete all nested resources before deleting this resource. | Delete the resources manually in the Azure portal.
This feature is intended to avoid the unintentional destruction of nested Resources provisioned through some other means \| | Delete the resources manually in the Azure portal.

user-assigned-identity-missing.statement: "User Assigned Identity ... was not found" is resolved by deleting the resource group and rerunning the template.

quotes: was not found | Delete the resource group and rerun the template.

rerun-transient.statement: The following errors are each documented with the resolution "Rerun the template": a 409 "The specified container is being deleted", VNet peering ReferencedResourceNotProvisioned, VMAgentStatusCommunicationError, RoleDefinitionWithSameNameExists, InternalDiskManagementError, RoleAssignmentUpdateNotPermitted, KeyVaultAuthenticationFailure, and a connection reset ("HTTP response was nil") on service principal creation.

quotes: unexpected status 409 (409 conflict) with error: ContainerOperationFailure: The specified container is being deleted.
The specified container is being deleted. Try operation later. | Rerun the template.
Resource is in Updating state and the last operation that updated/is updating the resource is PutSubnetOperation. | Rerun the template.
that it can establish outbound connections to Azure storage. Please refer to https://aka.ms/vmextensionlinuxtroubleshoot for additional VM agent troubleshooting information." | Rerun the template.
A custom role with the same name already exists in this directory. Use a different name. | Rerun the template.
An unexpected error occured while processing disk. Please retry later." | Rerun the template.
Tenant ID, application ID, principal ID, and scope are not allowed to be updated." | Rerun the template.
The operation failed because of authentication issue on the keyvault. | Rerun the template.
https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals": HTTP response was nil; connection may have been reset. | Rerun the template.

management-policy-not-found.statement: The ManagementPolicyNotFound error ("The key vault key is not found to unwrap the encryption key") appears twice with different documented resolutions: delete the storage account and rerun the template, or rerun the template.

quotes: The key vault key is not found to unwrap the encryption key. | Delete the storage account and rerun the template.
unwrap the encryption key. | Rerun the template.

rerun-rows-no-cause.title: Causes behind the error rows that resolve with a plain rerun
rerun-rows-no-cause.detail: Many error rows resolve with "Rerun the template" and give no cause. Rows not claimed: OSProvisioningTimedOut, StorageFailure/EncryptionScopeNotAvailable, Disk Encryption Set (connection reset and KeyVaultAccessForbidden) and the evidence role-not-found row.
